card.name: Imaging agent dosing text, before a number
card.fires_on: Spaces, digits and small words inside diagnostic imaging and radiopharmaceutical dosing text, such as the gap after 'to' in a dose range or the 9 in Tc 99m. It fires where the next word is likely a value or procedure name.

modes.label: Range gaps
modes.description: The space after 'to' in a dose range of contrast or radiotracer.
modes.example: mL/kg to 2 mL/kg 2 mL/s to 3 mL/s CT Urography 300 1 mL/kg to<< >>2 mL/kg 1 mL/s to

modes.label: Technetium names
modes.description: Digits or pieces inside Tc 99m agent names.
modes.example: Bone and Cardiac Imaging Technetium Tc <<9>>9m Pyrophosphate Injection is injected

modes.label: Small words before procedures
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'this' before an imaging administration or procedure.
modes.example: hydrate 4 hours prior to<< the>> administration of Fluorodopa F

card.writes: It slightly favors 'report' and 'reports' as next words, and disfavors measurement words like 'Measured' and 'monthly'.
card.plain: It lights up in nuclear medicine and contrast imaging dosing text, at spots inside agent names or dose ranges.
